description: Saddle's StableSwap metapool swapUnderlying performed virtual-price arithmetic that integer-divided amounts to zero under tiny inputs at a particular base-pool LP ratio, letting the pool return tokens without paying in. The flaw is below the well-known empty-pool donation pattern — it is in the precision of the StableSwap invariant under skewed reserves. vulnerable_contract is the sUSDv2 MetaSwap pool, confirmed in Saddle's official post-mortem and the Immunefi hack-analysis writeup.
